evidence.title: Peakflo — Agentic Workflows for Finance Automation

name: Peakflo
summary: Peakflo's finance-automation marketing site: agentic workflow templates, an ROI calculator and 40+ integrations.
description: A full marketing site for Peakflo (Y Combinator S21): hero for agentic invoice-to-cash workflows, AI capability cards, pre-built AP/AR workflow templates with volume and accuracy figures, an interactive AR & AP savings calculator, 40+ ERP, banking and messaging integrations, industry sections, customer stories, an FAQ and demo CTAs.
contains: hero: agentic workflows that automate invoice-to-cash
capability cards: AI extraction, validation, routing, multi-system sync, continuous learning
pre-built workflow templates with volumes and accuracy (10K+ bills/mo, 99.5% …)
interactive AR & AP savings calculator with live ROI output
40+ ERP, banking and messaging integrations: NetSuite, SAP, Xero, QuickBooks, Slack, WhatsApp
customer stories: Ninja Van, InMobi, Cove, Bharathi Homes, Vida, Driver Logistics
compliance badges (SOC 2, CASA Tier 2, PDPA) and a G2 rating
